manual.blackchannel.0.b: Black Channel is an in-world SIGINT layer for your tech-war server. The phone and laptop are terminals. The mod does not read real IPs and does not leave the Minecraft world. A dox here is the last radio fix, not the player's body. The fix goes stale. A decoy and a Faraday cage lie to the radar. A Ballistix EMP, and any blast whose exploder name contains emp, kills the terminals.
manual.blackchannel.1.b: Use the phone: chat, radar, market and gear. Sneak-use toggles airplane: you go dark, your fix freezes. Battery drains; charge with a cell or by using the phone on a rack. Handle is random; a new SIM burns it. @name in chat is DM. DARK needs an uplink (rack/dish/sat). LOCAL is heard only within 96 blocks, no rack needed. Without uplink radar shows only stations/beacons, with uplink it shows players too. Scroll chat with wheel.
manual.blackchannel.2.b: Uplink rack holds the darknet nearby. Fuel: coal, redstone, cell or Forge Energy. SIGINT dish relays a rack within 32 blocks, narrows trace spread and adds +80 radar nearby. Jammer cuts the channel inside its radius. Faraday cage hides you inside and is invisible on enemy radar. Sneak-empty-hand on your rack mutes your outgoing calls for #200.
manual.blackchannel.3.b: If the target is live (not airplane, not jammed, has battery and device) and inside radar, its handle auto-appears in Network: phone 52, laptop 110 (+80 near your dish). Without uplink players are hidden, only nodes. No coords beyond radar — distance only. Decoy prints handles in 50 blocks. Dog tag from body gives handle+nick, no point. TRACE is a paid beam: first shot gives beam ±spread, second from another spot (100+ blocks) intersects into a point ±error. Target noise narrows beam (up to -35%). VPN shifts the beam, broken by second shot. Target IDS alerts them with your bearing.
manual.blackchannel.4.b: DEANON binds a handle to a Minecraft name if you already have a fix, a signal sample, or a zero-day. It is a game name, not a real person. After that, the target's VPN no longer hides the name or shifts the blip on your radar. If they burn the handle, the name remains. The list is on the laptop and on the phone network tab. VPN blocks deanon until a zero-day is in the inventory. Cost #4. A target with IDS gets a bearing.
manual.blackchannel.5.b: SWAT hits the selected stored fix after a delay. It does not follow the body. Pick an INTEL row, then press SWAT. The target sees the timer and the coordinates and can leave. The blast is small, not a nuke. EMP on the aim point or on the operator aborts it. Block breaking is a config switch. Cost is #40, or #8 with a false contract in inventory.
manual.blackchannel.6.b: BOMB floods the target screen while their phone is on. Airplane mutes it but does not reset the timer: turn off early — spam returns. Phone radar is short, laptop longer, not stacked. The HUD toggle draws blips in the corner. Noise (top bar on phone) grows from your actions and decays in a minute; enemy noise narrows your beam. Bugs and squad beacons glow own color. Decoy beacon draws foreign handle. Superb Warfare drones show if the mod is there. UAV takes a fix off the nearest visible drone.
manual.blackchannel.7.b: Right-click VPN, deep VPN, IDS or hardening to install. Hardening leaves phone at 30 battery and halves EMP on racks. Faraday cage hides your trace inside and is invisible on enemy radar. Airplane removes you from air and kills radar. Ballistix EMP and any explosion with emp in name kills phones/laptops/racks in radius and cancels strikes. EW EMP gun on drone gives small side pulse. Node: N minutes before finale ends a point lights at map center — hold it alone with your squad for +1 every 10s.
manual.blackchannel.8.b: Right-click a Koryazhma coin to deposit. Sneak-use to withdraw. A charged rack mints coins: one payout per owner inside the mint radius, a distant base mints on its own. The phone market sells chips; hover a button for the price. On the laptop SLOT tab, drag an item into the slot and set the price with the slider. MAP and BAG snapshot the fix area and a torn inventory, not the body. Sneak-use a tracker on a player or a block. Right-click a signal sample to claim a bounty on that handle.
manual.blackchannel.9.b: /bc help, status, hooks. Match: /minigame center, size, team, start, stop. size is wall to wall, 2500 for 2500x2500. Pick a team in /minigame team before the start. Config: config/blackchannel-common.toml.

screen.blackchannel.area_about: Frame around fix %s ±%s. One cell is 4 blocks, the frame is about 64. Top is north. The center is not the body.

screen.blackchannel.area_dot: Red dot is in frame. It is a coarse cell, not body coordinates. Read the ground color around it.
screen.blackchannel.area_ground: Not in frame: they left, changed dimension, or are more than 32 blocks from the center.
screen.blackchannel.area_legend: Color is the block surface. Black is a hole, no cell. A red dot means the carrier may have been in that cell.

screen.blackchannel.area_pick: Next shot is fix %s ±%s. The frame center is that fix, already wrong. Do not stand on the center looking for the body.

screen.blackchannel.tip.airplane: Drops you off the air. Radar is empty, the fix stops updating, darknet is silent. Flood does not arrive while this is on, but the timer keeps running.
screen.blackchannel.tip.bomb: Costs %s. Spams the target's screen. Not a location.
screen.blackchannel.tip.crew: Crew code from the box. Shared racks and dishes. Friends are not hidden by VPN on radar, but enemies still see you.
screen.blackchannel.tip.deanon: Costs %s. Binds a handle to a Minecraft name. On your radar that target's VPN stops shifting the blip. The name remains after a handle wipe.
screen.blackchannel.tip.dnd: Mutes incoming darknet chat. It does not hide you from a trace or the radar.
screen.blackchannel.tip.noise: Noise builds from SAY, DM, TRACE, BOMB, HACK. Decays to zero in a minute. Loud target = narrower beam on your trace.
screen.blackchannel.tip.optic: Costs %s. A noisy picture of the ground around the fix, not a camera. Holes and shift grow with VPN and stale fixes.
screen.blackchannel.tip.peek: Costs %s. Some slots stay black. The farther the body is from the fix, the darker the picture.
screen.blackchannel.tip.radar_hud: Same blips in the corner. Players: phone %s, laptop %s. Stations out to %s. Dish +%s. A dead battery sends nothing.
screen.blackchannel.tip.scroll: Scroll wheel to see older messages.
screen.blackchannel.tip.sell_buff: Remove the chip and refund half its price to the wallet.
screen.blackchannel.tip.sell_intel: Lists the selected fix. Price comes from the slider or the number field.
screen.blackchannel.tip.sell_item: Lists the whole stack in the sale slot. Phones and laptops cannot be placed there.
screen.blackchannel.tip.swat: Costs %s, or %s with a contract. Hits the selected fix, not the body. Needs an uplink. Delay %ss.
screen.blackchannel.tip.trace: Costs %s. Error: base %s, VPN ×%s, deep VPN ×%s. Miss %s / %s / %s percent. A friendly dish tightens it. A stale fix adds %s.
screen.blackchannel.tip.uav: Costs %s. Drone operator within %s blocks. Error about %s. No rack required.
screen.blackchannel.tip.wipe: Two clicks. Burns the handle and the fixes. The second click confirms.
screen.blackchannel.tower.hint: Use empty hand on lodestone on tower — 20s hack (12s with exploit), noise 60/400. Gives 2/min, peleng 400, sector 600/60s, chat 800, intercept.
screen.blackchannel.tower.title: TOWERS
tooltip.blackchannel.cell: Use to restore 60 battery, or feed a rack.
tooltip.blackchannel.contract: Keep it in inventory. A false fire mission costs 8 instead of 40.
tooltip.blackchannel.defib: One charge: instantly revives you or a teammate, no five second hold.
tooltip.blackchannel.dog_tag: From a body. Right-click with a phone to file the handle and name. No coordinates.
tooltip.blackchannel.exploit: Keep it in inventory. TRACE misses less. Required to hack a foreign rack.
tooltip.blackchannel.harden: Use to harden against EMP. Phone keeps a charge, racks drain less.
tooltip.blackchannel.hash: Use to deposit. Sneak-use to withdraw up to 16.
tooltip.blackchannel.ids: Use to install IDS. Attacks ping a bearing back.
tooltip.blackchannel.laptop: Right-click: ops terminal. Sneak: radar HUD. Right-click a player to read a handle.
tooltip.blackchannel.logger: The block logs every handle within 50 blocks. On a chest, three short logs. Not coordinates, not an IP. Chest charges: %s
tooltip.blackchannel.sample: A captured handle. Use it to claim a bounty on that handle.
tooltip.blackchannel.sample_enc: Encrypted. A zero-day in inventory decrypts it.
tooltip.blackchannel.sat: Use to load 3 satellite charges. Works when no rack is nearby.
tooltip.blackchannel.sim: Sneak-use to burn the handle and roll a new one.
tooltip.blackchannel.vpn: Use to install VPN. Traces land off your body.
tooltip.blackchannel.vpn2: Use to install deep VPN. Traces often fail outright.
tooltip.blackchannel.zero: Keep it in inventory. DEANON ignores VPN and opens an encrypted sample.
